images.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, legible landscape editorial UI mockup for Ocean, a proposed personal computing environment. Image 1 of a dinner-planning walkthrough. Two panels on an off-white background: a large computer window on left (60%), a tablet on right (40%), front-on, minimal device frames. Familiar restrained UI: white surfaces, dark navy sans-serif text, teal controls, thin gray dividers, modest rounded corners; no futuristic effects, no decorative gradients. Small outer labels "1  Make a dinner planner" and "2  Adjust it by hand". Computer header "Ocean / This week". A compact side conversation shows user "Make a dinner planner from my recipes." and assistant "Ready. Pick meals, set servings, and build a shopping list." Main content title "This week", recipe cards "Lentil soup" Monday, "Veggie tacos" Tuesday, "Tomato pasta" Wednesday. Bottom reusable controls "Build shopping list" and "Save tool". A small strip says "Recipes → Meal plan → Shopping list". Tablet header "This week"; selected card "Veggie tacos" with label "Tuesday", stepper "Servings  −  4  +", button "Move to Thursday", lower list preview "Tortillas  8", "Beans  2 cans", and understated "Undo". Depict plausible editable controls, readable large text, generous spacing, no tiny filler text, no people. Screens are complementary views of the same meal-plan objects. Render crisp high quality at landscape aspect ratio.
